title: Greenbrix C1: 4 people the bank turns away
topic: Equity-based lending: 4 people the bank turns away
hook: The bank said no. That is not the final answer.
logline: Seven-slide Greenbrix Capital carousel for Krystian Catala: 4 people the bank turns away.
structure: 7 slides 1080x1350: cover (Krystian behind a stamped folder, lime sticky 'Not the final answer.'), business owner (tax return, declared income circled), rebuilder (credit gauge needle under 600), non-traditional earner (slips spilling out of a bank form), out of time (calendar), what we look at instead (property, equity, plan dividers), CTA index card on a lime YOUR FILE folder.
device: the Declined Pile: bank files stamped DECLINED (textured red rubber stamp), each holding the one document that sank it; Greenbrix's lime file tab reopens them and runs from the cover into slide 2 as the seamless join
lessons: BoC stat (about 9% of Toronto-CMA borrowers renewing in 2027 may be unable to refinance) is caption-only; wording must name the Financial Stability Report 2026 and say Toronto-area.
Confirm licence numbers #13645 and M12001607 on the FSRA register before posting.
